name: Kwame Okafor-Kjellberg
location: The Narrows, near Milwaukee and North Ave

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (60.2%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (20.2%) and East Asian (19.6%) ancestry, creating a striking tri-continental blend. West African bone structure and melanin dominates, complemented by warm Latin American undertones and subtle East Asian eye geometry.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined shoulders; moves with deliberate economy. No wasted motion.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Box braids pulled into a high crown knot, practical and intimidating
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (braids fall to mid-back when loose)
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with subtle monolid tendency from East Asian ancestry, alert and analytical
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with golden undertones from Sub-Saharan African heritage, warmed further by Latin American ancestry influence
physical_description.complexion: Clear skin with high, defined cheekbones reflecting both African and East Asian ancestry, full lips set in a neutral expression. Subtle warmth in undertones from tri-continental mix. A thin scar traces from left jaw to ear—old, deliberate, never regretted.
distinguishing_marks: Thin diagonal scar running from lower left jawline to behind left ear, approximately 8cm, pale and precise
Small geometric tattoo on inner right wrist: three interlocking circles in matte black ink
Faint burn marks on palms (both hands) in concentric circles, consistent with controlled exposure—subcutaneous conditioning evidence
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Her augmentations are deep—subcutaneous neural array for lie detection and microexpression reading, internal subvocal mic, distributed haptic feedback nodes. Only the faint telltale palmar scarring suggests enhancement.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with spine straight, always positioned to see exits. Hands rest visible on table or lap—never hidden. Moves between stillness and sudden precision; no fidgeting. Speaks from a centered diaphragm. Eyes track micro-movements in conversation partners.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 refined casual: fitted dark turtleneck (Sekitani brand, brushed synthetic), tailored charcoal cargo pants with hidden pockets, matte black reinforced shoes (non-descript, practical). A worn leather jacket over everything—buffalo leather, pre-2200s, patina that speaks of real use. No jewelry except a simple stainless steel chronometer on her left wrist. Aesthetic is 'professional operative who doesn't need to advertise.'
